description.zh:
要启用服务的入参信息，数据格式为JSON String，例如**Args={"param1":1}**。
若此参数为空时，需传入**Args={} **。

><notice>物模型功能定义数据类型为float或double时，对应参数值（即使值为整数）至少携带一位小数位。例如10.0、11.1。
></notice>
description.en:
The input parameter of the service. The value is a JSON string. Example: **Args={"param1": 1}**.

If this parameter is left empty, set the value to **Args={}**.

>If the TSL data is of the float or double type, the parameter values that correspond to the TSL data contain at least one decimal place. Examples: 10.0 and 11.1.

description.zh: 要调用服务的设备的名称列表。最多支持传入100个设备名称。
description.en: A list of names of the devices for which you want to invoke a service. You can specify up to 100 device names.

description.zh:
服务的标识符。

设备的服务**Identifier**的查看方式：

- 登录物联网平台控制台，在设备所属产品的**功能定义**中查看。
- 调用接口[QueryThingModel](~~150321~~)，从返回的物模型信息中查看。

> 如果是自定义（非默认）模块**testFb**下服务**testService**，则参数值为**testFb:testService**。
description.en:
The identifier of the service.

You can use one of the following methods to view the **identifier** of the service.

*   Log on to the IoT Platform console. On the **Define Feature** tab of the product to which the device belongs, you can view the identifier.
*   Call the [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) operation and view the identifier in the TSL information that is returned.

>  If a service named testService belongs to a custom module named testFb, you can set this parameter to ******testFb:testService******. The custom module is not the default module.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the ID of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.****

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.****
>*   If no **Overview** page or **ID** is generated for your instance, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 要调用服务的设备所隶属的产品**ProductKey**。
description.en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
目前只支持异步调用该接口。
调用服务到设备端后，设备会返回调用结果给接口的调用方。设备端响应逻辑及响应结果，需您在设备端完成开发。设备返回结果的数据格式必须符合标准的Alink协议，Alink JSON格式如下：
```
{
	"id": "58***89",
	"code": 200,
	"data": {},
	"message": "success",
	"localizedMsg": "localizedMsg"
}
```
> - **id**为物联网平台生成的唯一ID，设备从服务调用请求中获取，并原文返回。
- **code**为整型数字，会返回给接口调用方，用于判断服务调用结果。
- **data**为调用设备服务的结果数据，会返回给接口调用方。数据必须为JSON格式，由用户自行定义返回内容。
- **message**、**localizedMsg**根据业务需要进行返回。
例如物联网平台的设备接入C Link SDK提供了物模型使用示例，详细内容，请参见[调用服务](~~258239~~)。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享该阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
This API currently supports asynchronous invocation only.
After the service is invoked on the device side, the device returns the invocation result to the API caller. You must implement the response logic and response result on the device side. The data format of the result returned by the device must comply with the standard Alink protocol. The Alink JSON format is as follows:
```
{
	"id": "58***89",
	"code": 200,
	"data": {},
	"message": "success",
	"localizedMsg": "localizedMsg"
}
```
> - **id**: A unique ID generated by the IoT Platform. The device retrieves it from the service invocation request and returns it as-is.
- **code**: An integer value returned to the API caller to indicate whether the service invocation succeeded.
- **data**: The result data from invoking the device service, returned to the API caller. This data must be in JSON format, and its content is defined by the user.
- **message** and **localizedMsg**: Returned based on business requirements.
For example, the C Link SDK for device connection provided by the IoT Platform includes Thing Specification Language model usage examples. For more information, see [Invoke Services](~~258239~~).

## QPS Limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 10.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot invoke-things-service --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --qos 1 --identifier Set --args param1_:1 --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot InvokeThingsService --region cn-hangzhou --Args 'param1_:1' --Identifier Set --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Qos 1 --DeviceName.1 'example-string' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
